description: Two-Key SIEM events (0.7.0). Give every event an @timestamp so Kibana can show it: from sent_at in Two-Key's own schema, from metadata.logged_time in OCSF, and from the ingest time for a CEF line. ECS events already carry @timestamp. Nothing is added to the event itself.

date.if: ctx['@timestamp'] == null && ctx.metadata != null && ctx.metadata.logged_time != null
